visualReview.notes: All7 final portable images inspected. Flat lit asset stage isolates the corrected pale limestone casing, abrupt slope change, exposed crown and small portals; four reverse/turntable views and two details reviewed. No geographic ground claim from this isolated stage.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: All7 final shared-material images inspected, including native cardinal square overlay. Pale limestone/raw weathered masonry bindings and small opaque passage mouths render correctly. Geographic centroid, heading, native masonry-only ground opening, mount and unload pass.

mediumFiReview.notes: All19 final flat-ground context images inspected: noon/late economy/high street/block/skyline, silhouette, casing/crown details and four shipped LOD transitions. Bent silhouette remains clear at distance; close street cameras exercise the large casing surface. Synthetic surrounding buildings and review floor are not geographic fit evidence. The separately preserved source DEM has unresolved pyramid-return artifacts.

fidelityReview.scope: Surviving main Bent Pyramid exterior only; satellite pyramid, temples, causeway, enclosure and interior excluded.
fidelityReview.notes: Surviving large Bent Pyramid matches the inspected public-domain Qualla panorama: steep pale lower casing, distinct bend, shallower upper slope, weathered dark crown and localized stone loss.188m base and104.71m overall height are approximate; portal details and hidden-face patch positions are interpretations.
